# `provideLayerSucceedToProvideService`

Suggests providing inline Layer.succeed and Layer.effect services directly

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377124` |
| Language Service name | `provideLayerSucceedToProvideService` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/provide-layer-succeed-to-provide-service` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Context, Effect, Layer } from "effect"

class Service extends Context.Service<Service, { readonly value: number }>()("Service") {}

const program = Service.use((service) => Effect.succeed(service.value)).pipe(
  Effect.provide(Layer.succeed(Service, { value: 1 }))
/**
  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(provide-layer-succeed-to-provide-service): `Effect.provideService` provides this inline single-service layer directly.
*/
)
```

        }
